overview.zh: CP5.121是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP5.121 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：12 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：440 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 12 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 440 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

overview.zh: CP5.241是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP5.241 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：440 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 440 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CP5.241-S1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：440 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP5.242是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP5.242 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：440 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 440 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP5.481是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP5.481 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：440 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 48 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 440 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CP10.122 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：12 Vdc；输出功率：192 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：600 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 12 Vdc; Output power: 192 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 600 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP10.241是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP10.241 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：600 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 600 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

overview.zh: CP10.241-C1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP10.241-C1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：600 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 600 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP10.241-M1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP10.241-M1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：620 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 620 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP10.241-S1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP10.241-S1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：600 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 600 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP10.242是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP10.242 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：600 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 600 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

verification.zh: 判断：公开型号页可用于初选，网页已列参数与手册尚未逐项核对的内容应分开。选型需保留散热、安装空间、启动负载及失电响应余量。
verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: CP10.248是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP10.248 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：675 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 675 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP10.361是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP10.361 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：36 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：600 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 36 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 600 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

overview.zh: CP20.241是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP20.241 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：830 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 830 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: Rev.2.4手册的输入输出、接线、环境、可靠性、EMC、合规声明和应用工况表已补入；每项保留测试/配置条件。曲线未作插值，配件细图与系统认证仍须单独核对。
overview.en: Rev.2.4 tables for input/output,wiring,environment,reliability,EMC,compliance declarations and application conditions are included with their test/configuration scope.Curves are not interpolated;accessory fine drawings and system certification need separate verification.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

verification.zh: 判断：公开型号页可用于初选，网页已列参数与手册尚未逐项核对的内容应分开。选型需保留散热、安装空间、启动负载及失电响应余量。
verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: CP20.241-M1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP20.241-M1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：830 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 830 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

verification.zh: 判断：公开型号页可用于初选，网页已列参数与手册尚未逐项核对的内容应分开。选型需保留散热、安装空间、启动负载及失电响应余量。
verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: CP20.241-S2是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP20.241-S2 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：830 g；连接方式：Push-in clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 830 g; Connection method: Push-in clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: Rev.2.4手册的输入输出、接线、环境、可靠性、EMC、合规声明和应用工况表已补入；每项保留测试/配置条件。曲线未作插值，配件细图与系统认证仍须单独核对。
overview.en: Rev.2.4 tables for input/output,wiring,environment,reliability,EMC,compliance declarations and application conditions are included with their test/configuration scope.Curves are not interpolated;accessory fine drawings and system certification need separate verification.

verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: CP20.241-V1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP20.241-V1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：830 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 830 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: Rev.2.4手册的输入输出、接线、环境、可靠性、EMC、合规声明和应用工况表已补入；每项保留测试/配置条件。曲线未作插值，配件细图与系统认证仍须单独核对。
overview.en: Rev.2.4 tables for input/output,wiring,environment,reliability,EMC,compliance declarations and application conditions are included with their test/configuration scope.Curves are not interpolated;accessory fine drawings and system certification need separate verification.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

verification.zh: 判断：公开型号页可用于初选，网页已列参数与手册尚未逐项核对的内容应分开。选型需保留散热、安装空间、启动负载及失电响应余量。
verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: CP20.242是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP20.242 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：830 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 830 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CP20.242-IOL is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：835 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 835 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP20.248是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP20.248 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：835 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 835 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP20.248-IOL是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP20.248-IOL is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：835 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 835 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。

overview.zh: CPS20.241是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CPS20.241 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1000 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1000 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CPS20.361是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CPS20.361 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：36 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1000 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 36 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1000 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CPS20.481是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CPS20.481 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1000 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 48 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1000 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CS5.241-C1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CS5.241-C1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CS5.241-S1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CS5.241-S1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：500 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 500 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

verification.zh: 判断：公开型号页可用于初选，网页已列参数与手册尚未逐项核对的内容应分开。选型需保留散热、安装空间、启动负载及失电响应余量。
verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: CS5.243是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CS5.243 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CS5.244 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

verification.zh: 判断：公开型号页可用于初选，网页已列参数与手册尚未逐项核对的内容应分开。选型需保留散热、安装空间、启动负载及失电响应余量。
verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: CS10.241-S1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CS10.241-S1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：700 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 700 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CS10.242 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：800 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 800 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：700 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 700 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CS10.244是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CS10.244 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：700 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 700 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: QS5.241 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：40 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：620 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 40 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 620 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: QS5.241-A1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QS5.241-A1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：40 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：620 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 40 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 620 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: QS10.121是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QS10.121 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：12 Vdc；输出功率：180 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：930 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 12 Vdc; Output power: 180 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 930 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: QS10.241-A1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QS10.241-A1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：900 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 900 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: QS10.241-D1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：900 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: QS10.301是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QS10.301 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：28 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：900 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 28 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 900 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: QS10.481-D1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QS10.481-D1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：900 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 48 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 900 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: QS20.241-A1 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：82 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1200 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 82 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1200 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: QS20.361是PULS DIMENSION目录中的单相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QS20.361 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：36 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：82 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1200 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 36 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 82 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1200 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: QS40.244 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：125 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1800 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 125 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1800 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: QS40.361 is a single-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：36 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：125 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1900 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 36 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 125 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1900 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：125 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1800 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CT5.241 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：40 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 40 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CT10.241 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：62 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：750 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 62 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 750 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CT10.241-C1 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：62 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：750 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 62 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 750 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: QT20.241-C1 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：870 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: QT20.361 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：36 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：870 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 36 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 870 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。

verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: QT40.241是PULS DIMENSION目录中的三相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QT40.241 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：110 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 110 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: QT40.241-B2是PULS DIMENSION目录中的三相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QT40.241-B2 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：110 mm x 124 mm x 143 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 110 mm x 124 mm x 143 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: QT40.242 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：110 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 110 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: QT40.361 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：36 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：110 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 36 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 110 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: QT40.481是PULS DIMENSION目录中的三相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QT40.481 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：110 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 48 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 110 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: XT40.241是PULS DIMENSION目录中的三相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: XT40.241 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1400 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1400 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: XT40.242 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1400 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1400 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

overview.zh: XT40.361是PULS DIMENSION目录中的三相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: XT40.361 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：36 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1400 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 36 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1400 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: XT40.362 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：36 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1400 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 36 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1400 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: XT40.482是PULS DIMENSION目录中的三相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: XT40.482 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1400 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 48 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1400 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: XT40.721是PULS DIMENSION目录中的三相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: XT40.721 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：72 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1400 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。

overview.zh: XT40.722是PULS DIMENSION目录中的三相导轨电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: XT40.722 is a three-phase din-rail power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：72 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1400 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 72 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 96 mm x 124 mm x 159 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 1400 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CD5.051 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：5 Vdc；输出功率：50 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：425 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 5 Vdc; Output power: 50 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 425 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CD5.121是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DC/DC转换器，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CD5.121 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：12 Vdc；输出功率：96 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：425 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 12 Vdc; Output power: 96 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 425 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CD5.241是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DC/DC转换器，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CD5.241 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：425 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 425 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CD5.242 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：120 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：425 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 120 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 425 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CD5.243 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：96 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：435 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 96 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 435 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.en: CD10.241 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：42 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 42 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CD10.242是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DC/DC转换器，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CD10.242 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：42 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：520 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 42 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 520 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CD10.482是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DC/DC转换器，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CD10.482 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：42 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：500 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 48 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 42 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 500 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP10.241-60是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DC/DC转换器，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP10.241-60 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：200 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：620 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 200 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 620 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CPS20.241-60是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DC/DC转换器，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CPS20.241-60 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24.5 Vdc；输出功率：400 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：980 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24.5 Vdc; Output power: 400 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 980 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.
