overview.zh: CPS20.481-D1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DC/DC转换器，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CPS20.481-D1 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：48 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：940 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 48 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 65 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 940 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

verification.zh: 判断：公开型号页可用于初选，网页已列参数与手册尚未逐项核对的内容应分开。选型需保留散热、安装空间、启动负载及失电响应余量。
verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: QS5.241-60是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DC/DC转换器，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QS5.241-60 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：100 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：40 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：640 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 100 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 40 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 640 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: QS10.241-60是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DC/DC转换器，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QS10.241-60 is a dc/dc converter explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：200 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：920 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 200 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 920 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: CP10.241-R1 is a power supply with integrated decoupling explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：600 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 600 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP10.241-R2-C1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的集成解耦功能的冗余电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP10.241-R2-C1 is a power supply with integrated decoupling explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：600 g；连接方式：Plug connector。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 600 g; Connection method: Plug connector.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP10.242-R2是PULS DIMENSION目录中的集成解耦功能的冗余电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP10.242-R2 is a power supply with integrated decoupling explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：240 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：600 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 240 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 39 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 600 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP20.241-R2是PULS DIMENSION目录中的集成解耦功能的冗余电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP20.241-R2 is a power supply with integrated decoupling explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：850 g；连接方式：Plug connector。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 850 g; Connection method: Plug connector.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP20.241-R2-C1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的集成解耦功能的冗余电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP20.241-R2-C1 is a power supply with integrated decoupling explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：850 g；连接方式：Plug connector。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 850 g; Connection method: Plug connector.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: CP20.245-R2是PULS DIMENSION目录中的集成解耦功能的冗余电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: CP20.245-R2 is a power supply with integrated decoupling explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：480 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：850 g；连接方式：Plug connector。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 480 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 48 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 850 g; Connection method: Plug connector.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: QS5.DNET是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DeviceNet电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QS5.DNET is a devicenet power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：91 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：40 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：620 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 91 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 40 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 620 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

verification.zh: 判断：公开型号页可用于初选，网页已列参数与手册尚未逐项核对的内容应分开。选型需保留散热、安装空间、启动负载及失电响应余量。
verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: QS10.DNET是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DeviceNet电源，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: QS10.DNET is a devicenet power supply explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：192 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：900 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 192 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 60 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 900 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: UF20.241 is a buffer module explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc / 22.5 Vds；尺寸（宽×高×深）：64 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：740 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc / 22.5 Vds; Dimensions (WxHxD): 64 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 740 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: UF20.481 is a buffer module explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：64 mm x 124 mm x 102 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：740 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。

verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: UBC10.241-N1是PULS DIMENSION目录中的内置电池式DC-UPS，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: UBC10.241-N1 is a dc-ups with built-in battery explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc / 22.5 Vds；尺寸（宽×高×深）：123 mm x 124 mm x 119 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：850 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc / 22.5 Vds; Dimensions (WxHxD): 123 mm x 124 mm x 119 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 850 g; Connection method: Spring clamps.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: UC10.241 is a dc-ups with capacitor storage explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc / 22.5 Vds；尺寸（宽×高×深）：126 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1150 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: UC10.242 is a dc-ups with capacitor storage explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc / 22.5 Vds；尺寸（宽×高×深）：198 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：1720 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: UB10.241 is a dc-ups control unit explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc / 22.5 Vds；尺寸（宽×高×深）：49 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：530 g；连接方式：Spring clamps。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: UB40.241是PULS DIMENSION目录中的DC-UPS控制单元，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: UB40.241 is a dc-ups control unit explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 额定电压：24 Vdc；输出功率：960 W；尺寸（宽×高×深）：46 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：530 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Nominal voltage: 24 Vdc; Output power: 960 W; Dimensions (WxHxD): 46 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 530 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: YRM2.DIODE是PULS DIMENSION目录中的二极管冗余模块，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: YRM2.DIODE is a diode redundancy module explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：350 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Dimensions (WxHxD): 32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 350 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: YR20.242 is a mosfet redundancy module explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：250 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: YR20.246 is a mosfet redundancy module explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：32 mm x 124 mm x 117 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：310 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

integration.zh: 按准确订货号核对机械安装、接线和适配设备。连续输出、浪涌、短路电流、温度降额、缓冲时间和电池容量分别评价；不得以某一项峰值替代整机供电能力。
integration.en: Verify mounting, wiring and compatible equipment by exact ordering number. Evaluate continuous output, inrush, short-circuit current, derating, buffering and battery capacity separately; a peak value does not establish overall system power capability.

verification.en: Assessment: published model tables support initial selection, distinct from manual contents not yet reviewed. Allow for thermal conditions, installation space, startup load and loss-of-power behavior.

overview.zh: YR40.245是PULS DIMENSION目录中的MOSFET冗余模块，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: YR40.245 is a mosfet redundancy module explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：46 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：340 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Dimensions (WxHxD): 46 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 340 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: YR40.482是PULS DIMENSION目录中的MOSFET冗余模块，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: YR40.482 is a mosfet redundancy module explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：46 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：360 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Dimensions (WxHxD): 46 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 360 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: YR80.241 is a mosfet redundancy module explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：46 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：440 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: YR80.242是PULS DIMENSION目录中的MOSFET冗余模块，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。用于设备供电或能源管理的具体配置，应按输入、输出、连接方式与环境条件选型。
overview.en: YR80.242 is a mosfet redundancy module explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. Select this equipment-power or energy-management configuration by its input, output, connection and environmental conditions.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：46 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：370 g；连接方式：螺钉端子。
overview.en: Dimensions (WxHxD): 46 mm x 124 mm x 127 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 370 g; Connection method: Screw terminals.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: UZO12.07是PULS DIMENSION目录中的不含电池的安装模块，按官网明确列出的独立订货型号建档。该型号不含电池，不能继承对应含电池组件的容量或运行时间。
overview.en: UZO12.07 is a battery mounting module without battery explicitly listed in the PULS DIMENSION catalog. This item excludes batteries and does not inherit battery capacity or runtime.

overview.zh: 尺寸（宽×高×深）：155 mm x 124 mm x 112 mm；设备质量（不含包装）：550 g。
overview.en: Dimensions (WxHxD): 155 mm x 124 mm x 112 mm; Weight per unit (excl. packaging): 550 g.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.zh: 适用范围为机器人控制柜、配套自动化设备及其能源管理。目录中列出的用途或认证资料不等于本型号已在某款机器人上验证；电源、电池、控制器和安全回路仍需进行系统级匹配。
overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.

overview.en: Relevant scope is robot control cabinets, associated automation equipment and energy management. A catalog application or certification link does not prove validation on a particular robot; power supplies, batteries, controllers and safety circuits require system-level matching.
